source.author: Jameson Hodge
source.note: CHIMERA's own definitions, serialized from its structures by crates/chimera/examples/tract_dump.rs (artic-spec); the gesture rules are transcribed from the planner with file:line references.

units: template coordinates in cm (head frame of the adult male template: x forward, y up, glottis at the origin), scaled per body by HumanVocalTract::p (human.rs:685); velum in cm^2 before the body scale (port = max(0, velum) * k^2); 0..1 for curl, lip width, labiodental, lateral, epilarynx, ventricular, dorsum

articulators.dynamics: each articulator is a critically damped second-order system: x'' = w^2 (T - x) - 2 w x', w = 2 pi hz * speed, semi-implicit Euler at the control step (control/articulators.rs:109-146); HumanVoice steps it every 64 output samples at 2x oversampling (128 internal samples at 96 kHz, 1.333 ms) (voice/human_voice.rs:226, 434)
articulators.targetClamp: the blended target is clamped to [min, max] before the step (control/articulators.rs:137)
articulators.speed: per articulator, the largest speed multiplier among gestures whose window (t0 - rampIn .. t1 + rampOut + releaseHold) contains t (control/score.rs:405 blend_all)

tipFree.rule: while no gesture sets the tip (tip_free, the default), the tip's target follows rest_tip(jaw, tbX, tbY) of the current state

blending.gestures: each control key's value is the weighted mean of the active gestures' targets, weight = activation * strength; activation is 0..1 with raised-cosine ramps of rampIn before t0 and rampOut after t1 (control/score.rs:273, 405)
blending.base: the performer's base posture joins every key with weight 0.05 while a score plays: T = (base * 0.05 + value * weight) / (0.05 + weight) (voice/human_voice.rs:445, control/articulators.rs:128)
blending.velum: bounded key: T = base + min(1, weight / 2) * (value - base), so a strength-4 gesture takes the velum fully and a weak one barely (control/articulators.rs:54, 121)

contact.rule: after each control step the geometry is computed; if the tongue tip or body penetrates the oral roof by more than 0.1 * k cm (max_penetration), it is projected back along the roof normal and its inward velocity removed (inelastic)

vowel.plusTipWhenCurl: ttX, ttY too when the vowel's ttCurl > 0.05 (rhotic)
vowel.note: vowel gestures overlap through consonants (Ohman): the next vowel ramps in over most of the gap

dominant.window: from closure - early to max(closure + 0.01, release - lead)
dominant.speed: the manner speed below; body-only consonants (dominant all in tbX, tbY, root) use 1 + (speed - 1) * 0.35

velarPlace.rule: a body-only consonant's own tbX is moved to a separate weak gesture, so its front-back place follows the vowel

alveolarFronting.applies: place alveolar, no tbX target, manner stop, nasal, fricative, affricate or tap

lead.note: closing = stop, nasal, affricate; lips only = dominant all in lipAp, labiodental

affricate.rule: closure gesture (the affricate's own targets, speed 2.0) from t0 to t0 + 0.55 dur; release gesture (the 'release' fricative's targets, speed 1.4) from split + 0.008 to t1

tap.rule: the stop's targets at speed 2.8; default duration 25 ms (ɾ), so in running speech the contact is brief

trill.rule: n = max(2, round(26 dur)) gestures of 0.35 / 26 s at speed 3.2

nasal.rule: velum gesture to 0.45 from t0 - 0.02 to t1 - 0.02, rampIn 0.05, rampOut 0.03, strength 4 (bounded key)

palatalization.rule: the tongue body goes toward /j/'s targets on the body coordinates (tbX, tbY) the consonant itself does not dominate, from t0 until the voice returns, strength 3, ramps 0.04; not for palatal consonants or glottals

preplacedClosure.rule: a stop closing behind another stop's closure, its articulators already set by the segment before, aims its closure 25 ms later (at most dur - 0.03)

glottal.h: abduction 0.33 from t0 - 0.01 to t1, ramps 0.03 / 0.035, strength 5
glottal.note: no oral targets: the oral posture is the surrounding vowels'

voiceless.stopOrAffricate: abduction 0.36 aspirated (0.22 not) from t0 + 0.25 dur to t1 + VOT share; aspirated by default when syllable-initial before a vowel and not after /s/

calibration.rule: fricative constriction coordinates calibrated per body to hit target areas (area * k^2) in an /ɑ/ context with jaw 0.55 (chimera-cli calibrate.rs:281); consonantTargetsByBody is base targets merged with consonantTargets.generated.json

vowelTargetsRef: crates/chimera/src/phonetics/vowelTargets.generated.json via planner.rs:74 vowel_artic (VOWEL_KEYS only, plus the tip for rhotics)

notes.ɾ: CHIMERA's alveolar tap: ALV_STOP targets (same as t, d), manner tap, dominant ttX ttY, 25 ms, gesture speed 2.8
notes.ɫ: not in the bellows 40, included: velarised lateral, ALV_STOP plus lateral 1, tbX 1.9, tbY 6.8, dominant ttX ttY lateral tbX tbY, 75 ms
notes.l: ALV_STOP plus lateral 1.0; the lateral channel is an area floor lateral * 0.35 k^2 on oral rays within 1.4 k cm of the tip (anatomy/human.rs:1203)
notes.ɹ: tip 5.35 / 9.35, curl 0.85, lipProt 0.5, lipWidth 0.3, root -0.6, body 2.3 / 7.1; dominant ttX ttY ttCurl lipProt lipWidth root
notes.e: a monophthong target exists (vowelTargets); the planner expands eɪ to e + i
notes.o: a monophthong target exists; the planner expands oʊ to o + u
